items.title: Lucid’s Stock Collapses–Again
items.summary: Lucid's new CEO unveiled a sweeping list of fixes, partnerships, and bold promises, but Wall Street responded by punishing the stock hard. The question now is whether the company can survive long enough to compete in markets dominated by rivals with far deeper pockets.

items.title: Exclusive: Uber cuts AI costs even as usage jumps

items.title: Baidu (BIDU) Takes Apollo Go Driverless Rides Overseas With Dubai Launch
items.summary: Baidu (NasdaqGS:BIDU) is rolling out its fully driverless Apollo Go robotaxis on the Uber platform in Dubai through a new partnership. The deal marks Baidu's first commercial deployment of autonomous vehicles outside China using a major global ridesharing app. Riders in Dubai will be able to book Apollo Go autonomous trips directly within the Uber app as the service launches. The move expands Baidu's international mobility footprint and links its autonomous driving technology with Uber's...

items.title: Uber publishes formal offer document for Delivery Hero takeover
items.summary: Investing.com -- Uber on Thursday published the formal offer document for its voluntary takeover bid for Delivery Hero, after receiving approval from German financial regulator BaFin, kicking off an acceptance period that runs from August 27 to November 5.
